summary: Avalo Therapeutics filed an 8-K regarding a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants. On May 5, 2026, it entered an underwriting agreement with Leerink Partners, TD Securities, and BofA Securities to sell 19,730,000 shares at $17.75/share and 1,400,000 pre-funded warrants at $17.749/warrant. The underwriters fully exercised a 30-day option for an additional 3,169,500 shares. Net proceeds of ~$405M will fund clinical development of abdakibart and working capital. The offering closed May 7, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no structural complexity or event-driven angle beyond the takedown.
